status: Observed source SKU-presence evidence; not an Amazon guarantee or company-allocation rule.

method.row_population: All structurally parsed content rows, including zero amounts; TSV header and metadata row excluded.
method.sku_test: The content-row sku cell is nonblank after stripping whitespace.
method.signature_normalization: Strip surrounding whitespace for comparison; do not merge spelling variants or alter raw source cells.
method.preprocess_filtering: No marketplace, company, fee, classification, or posting-window business validation filters the audited rows.
method.coverage: EU/FE queries used every active canonical marketplace in each configured credential scope and exhausted listing chunks/pages.
method.deduplication: EU/FE repeated identical decoded TSV bytes with the same settlement ID count once; distinct same-ID bodies must be flagged, not arbitrarily selected.

coverage.discovery_window: Earlier 90-day discovery sample; exact request timestamps not retained in the combined audit.
coverage.deduplication: 18 distinct retained normalized report records; original raw bytes and settlement header IDs unavailable for a stronger identity check.
